status: Eight Los Angeles-area Facebook Marketplace options, each pictured in the same room. Seven asking prices are below $500. No seller has been contacted and no sofa has been purchased or substituted into the working budget.
imageMethod: Room studies use the same budget-room image and the actual seller photo, preserving the seller's upholstery color. AI pixels are illustrative, not dimensionally exact. Listed widths and depths control the plan's outside bounding rectangle; the actual curve remains approximate. Seller estimates, probable model matches and Greg's requested photo estimate are explicitly labeled. Options without dimensions show the assumption used to make the picture and no scaled sofa footprint. None is a verified site fit.
budgetAssumptions: Each comparison replaces only the $1,252.99 baseline sofa. It recalculates 10% materials tax, 3% materials delivery and 10% contingency. Pickup and cleaning are additional stated allowances, not quotes; existing delivery reserves remain. Repair or reupholstery is not priced. The $1,200 Kardiel exceeds the unchanged Balanced allocation after allowances but fits More cost protection. Other furniture and saved layouts remain unchanged.
